name: Test helper for hosted worlds
description: Console commands for manual tests in a hosted (offline) world, which has no chat: give (materials, consumables and ammunition the player has found before), time, tp, where, heal, hurt, stamina, mana, spawn (hostile creatures that give no XP or loot; no bosses) and clear. Run them through <game>/kiln/control/console/<name>.cmd. It never grants experience, levels, skill points, knowledge or recipes.
